notes: All six source refs opened this session: issue body, both comments (11710175, 11710515 verbatim), fix commit 4ea5ea7f (parent 87c39d2d matches broken_rev; diff adds the standalone xacro and launcher as described), robot_model-1.8.1 urdf_parser.cpp:157-158 ('No link elements found in urdf file') and joint_state_listener.cpp:127-129 ('kdl_parser::treeFromParam("robot_description", tree)' + 'Failed to extract kdl tree from xml robot description'). Eligibility walk independently confirms step 6: the expanded model (value with no <link>) crosses param:robot_description and the consumer rejects it; deployment_wiring is correctly rejected because no loadable standalone artifact existed (the fix creates one). DISAGREEMENT on class only: the spec's failed_conditions[0].class is 'representation_convention', but representation_convention covers 'component or byte order, handedness, or encoding of a value crossing the boundary'; a structurally empty model is none of these, and the spec's own notes state classification 'other' is used — the JSON field contradicts its own notes. Loudness loud_documented/activate is supported: ROS_ERROR diagnostics from the robot_model stack plus roslaunch process-death report at node start-up.
